# Terminal symbols

Unmodified `SymbolsNerdFontMono-Regular.ttf` from Nerd Fonts **v3.4.0**.

Source: https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/tree/v3.4.0/patched-fonts/NerdFontsSymbolsOnly

SHA-256: `f0f624d9b474bea1662cf7e862d44aebe1ae1f6c7f9cb7a0ca5d0e5ac9561c60`

The upstream LICENSE and README are retained beside the font. The font and license are copied into PocketDSH's resources. The 2,507,556-byte symbols-only face supplies terminal icons on all Apple clients; the main text remains the native monospaced font. This avoids depending on fonts installed on the Mac or adding a whole patched font family. Register the font by its PostScript name, `SymbolsNFM`.

When updating, use a tagged upstream asset, update the checksum and retain upstream notices. Verify BMP and supplementary-plane icons in both the live emulator and retained output on Apple clients.
